prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: How many times are you going to “upgrade” me to a middle seat?  Especially after I’ve unselected the Delta Comfort upgrade option?
Delta: Thanks for bringing this to our attention. I apologize for the confusion. *AMC

Customer: do not "upgrade" me to a middle comfort+ seat ever again. This is a nightmare sandwiched. Fix the system #diamond
Delta: Hi Nick. I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience. Please follow/DM your confirmation code or tkt # to better assist. *TKR

Customer: you really need to add an option to not upgrade to the middle Delta comfort seat... Moving from 17B to 13D is not an upgrade...
Delta: Hello Frank. We can remove that option in your preferences, so you will only be upgraded to Delta Comfort+ at the airport.  I do not have another seat to offer you at this time. I am so sorry.  *TMS

Customer: and  conspired against me to change my aisle seat to a middle seat https://t.co/3yhR7Tq2rZ
Delta: Hi, John. I will be happy to assist with your seat selection. Please share your confirmation number via DM for review.  *AJZ https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: service_complaint):
"""Why does Delta upgrade me to a middle seat each time despite my preferences?? Frustrating!! Plus 2h wait on gold med line! Bad!!!"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the inconvenience. Please DM us your confirmation number so we can review your seat preferences and the wait you experienced.
